text: Union Bank lent two hundred and thirteen for every hundred it raised. Meet number two.
Clue one. Karnataka Bank's loans grew eighteen thousand crore. Deposits, just twelve thousand. A hundred and forty nine for every hundred.
Clue two. Its loan to deposit ratio jumped from seventy two to eighty percent.
The twist. The cheap money held up. CASA grew fifteen percent, faster than deposits.
Growing fast, funding well, but the cushion is thinning. Back to the napkin.
